fusions.name: Heat Ball
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that deals 8 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smoker's Puff
fusions.desc: Puffs smoke 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 fire damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Hindered], attacking slower, for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fever Pitch
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 25% for 12 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 13 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shivering Heat
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack of heat builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
